title: tragacantha coronilla
intro: Tragacantha coronilla, commonly known as French lavender or yellow pea, is a flowering plant species in the legume family. It has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The health benefits of Tragacantha coronilla include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
